narrative: A messaging group post offers early access ticket passes.

message.body: Hey everyone! Campus Music Fest early bird passes are live on this portal for 2 hours only. Limited 50 passes left!

evidence.label: Forwarded Tag
evidence.value: Forwarded message from unknown original sender

evidence.label: Official Student Union Ticketing Portal
evidence.value: Official portal lists early bird sales starting tomorrow, not today.

consequence_text.safe: Checking the official union portal revealed the message was an unofficial link.
consequence_text.unsafe: Clicking unverified ticket links in chat groups can lead to credential phishing.

teaching_point: Forwarded scarcity offers in chat channels should be cross-referenced with official ticket portals.
